AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#611 @ ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Independent read-only T3 public-policy/route audit; no candidate code changed. The owner approval of the three D2 passages at this exact head is acknowledged and is not reopened on stylistic or legal-copy preference. [Approval record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611#issuecomment-5937089620)

### B: must fix before merge

**B-611-1 — the disclosed community-AI purpose is not the implemented purpose.** `src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts:193,206,349` describes Anthropic community processing as review of rule-breaking content / moderation. The actual referenced implementation classifies and summarizes a coach's unanswered inbox, including routine wins, form checks, general items and no-action items; it sends author display name, cohort name, item ID, age and message/post excerpt, not just potentially rule-breaking posts. This is a material purpose/scope mismatch in a health-data disclosure, even with the “if enabled” qualifier. [Policy claims](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L188-L215), [health-policy recipient disclosure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L344-L351), [actual inbox purposes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/community/ai-triage/triage-output.schema.ts#L3-L35), [actual provider prompt](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/community/ai-triage/prompts/inbox-triage.prompt.ts#L83-L117).

Minimal fix: accurately describe optional AI prioritisation/summarisation of unanswered community posts and messages for the coach, including the accompanying identifiers/excerpts, in both policies and the provider bullet; preserve the optional-box consent boundary. Obtain approval for the corrected disclosure and add content assertions reflecting the real purpose, not “moderation.” Alternatively explicitly exclude the unshipped triage feature from the policy/release and keep it disabled. These tests currently prove text presence/escaping, not the truth of the described runtime purpose. [Current disclosure tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/test/trust-pages.spec.ts)

### Verified

- Bare routes `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/consumer-health-privacy` are public controller GETs; all are excluded from `/api` in main.ts, with HTML, 200 responses, 60/min throttling and five-minute static caching. New links are escaped, schemes constrained, and the consumer-health policy is linked throughout the public trust/help/signup/download surfaces. [Routes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/public-pages/public-pages.controller.ts#L88-L123), [prefix exclusions](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/main.ts#L158-L170), [renderer/link safety](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L689-L751).
- D2 collection/AI separation, Settings withdrawal and account-deletion paths match the approved wording; the consumer-health Consent section is verbatim, and no policy still advertises the superseded single-box model. [D2 copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L365-L371), [approved updates](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611#issuecomment-5937089620).
- WA policy includes categories, sources, shared categories, recipients, rights, withdrawal, recipient contacts, authenticated requests without a new account, free requests twice annually, 45-day response plus one 45-day extension, 45-day written appeal response and backup deletion within six months of authentication; these align with the cited statutory disclosure/deadline provisions, not a legal-compliance certification. [Policy rights](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L374-L410), [RCW 19.373](https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=19.373&full=true&pdf=true).
- The stated own-client context/no private coach notes matches the scoped #602 context implementation; #601 implements owner-self Roman access, immediate message removal on client deletion and a daily 180-day message-level retention sweep. These are pending dependencies, not proof they run in production or proof that the new #622 ledger already gates every AI path. [Context implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/bb5f13b0c87de378df6411a7bc159c63ff1e20ea/src/roman/context/roman-client-context.service.ts), [Roman hard transcript removal](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/d767f65cef5d0ce84242c9e7f3179f36aeb27fec/src/roman/roman.service.ts#L158-L174), [180-day job](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/d767f65cef5d0ce84242c9e7f3179f36aeb27fec/src/roman/roman-retention.service.ts).

### Release boundaries / optional documentation follow-up

**C-611-1:** update the ship-order documentation to the current D2 split: #622 ledger + #310 withdrawal UI, and #601/R2b enforcement of that ledger before *any* client data goes to Anthropic; the PR's ship-order bullets still say “single box.” Publishing these present-tense promises before the described behavior is deployed is explicitly prohibited by the PR header. Account-deletion promises additionally depend on #608/#313, and #608 is still in a fix round. [Ship-order declaration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611)

Processor deletion notifications, backup/PITR retention, vendor contractual no-training/no-advertising, response SLAs and staff-access operating rules need operator evidence before publication; source code and the owner’s copy approval alone do not establish that these manual/vendor commitments are actually met. The PR itself calls out those unverified commitments. [Operational evidence gaps](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611)

Live page reads in this audit still showed the pre-#611 Privacy/Terms dated 2026-04-27; the new consumer-health URL returned a fetch error, so I am not claiming the candidate policy is deployed. Candidate routing is verified separately from live content. [Live Privacy Policy](https://app.trygrowthproject.com/privacy), [live Terms](https://app.trygrowthproject.com/terms), [intended consumer-health URL](https://app.trygrowthproject.com/consumer-health-privacy).

### Tests / CI

Shared deps, no install; private Prisma generated via heavy.sh. `npx jest --runInBand --ci test/trust-pages.spec.ts test/help-pages.spec.ts test/public-pages.spec.ts test/invite-landing.spec.ts` via heavy.sh: **4 suites / 79 tests passed**. `git diff --check` clean. These are copy/render/controller unit tests, not a production privacy-enforcement or vendor-deletion test.

Every required exact-head check ran and passed: [build-and-test](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073071/job/110496741904), [RLS floor](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073071/job/110496741317), [RLS live](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073071/job/110496741467), [MWB-3 live](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073071/job/110496741407), [npm audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073427/job/110496742228), [CodeQL JS/TS](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073282/job/110496742550), [banned casts](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073059/job/110496741641), [SBOM](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073112/job/110496741659), [danger](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073197/job/110496741016); [CodeQL aggregate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/runs/110498066215) also passed. The separate deploy-readiness-gate is skipped; it is not counted as an executed privacy/production acceptance gate. [Skipped deployment gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/36900073226/job/110496743074)

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#611 @ ced10667da231ac3e0102132f1c137856568fcec — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

This is an independent T4 audit of the public Privacy Policy, Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy and Terms. It was read-only: I did not build this PR and I pushed no code.
- Range: `bffae5f3..ced10667` (3 commits, 9 files).
- I rendered every page with `renderTrustPage()` and compared the text line by line with the approval file (Appendices A and B, and the section 5 Consent replacement) and with the owner's approval of the three new D2 passages (comment 5937089620).
- I checked the claims against backend main, #608 @ `b0beb076`, #622 and the operator's production facts.

### What checked out
**Approved copy is byte-exact.**
- The rendered Privacy Policy and CHP differ from Appendices A and B only in:
  - the date (2026-10-01);
  - link-target annotations;
  - Privacy Policy "Roman and AI" paragraphs 1 and 3 (approved as written at this head);
  - the CHP Consent section.
- The CHP Consent section matches the approved replacement word for word, both paragraphs. The straight apostrophe in "coach's" is HTML-escaped and renders exactly.
- The Terms sentence on consultation and AI is the approved sentence at this head.

**Routes.**
- `@Get('consumer-health-privacy')` is `@Public` and throttled. `'consumer-health-privacy'` is added to the `setGlobalPrefix` exclude list (`main.ts:167`), next to `privacy` and `terms`, which are already live.
- The footer links are relative (`/privacy`, `/consumer-health-privacy`) on the trust, help and signup/download pages.

**Matches real practice.**
- 14-day grace and re-auth deletion match #608 (`DELETION_GRACE_DAYS` default 14; recent-auth with password or Apple).
- What deletion removes matches the #608 README (posts, DMs, voice notes, transcripts, samples; payment records kept).
- Coach visibility matches. No clinic-partner data flow exists.
- The vendors named are the vendors in code.
- 16+ is stated.

**WA My Health My Data rights.**
- The policy covers confirm and access, the recipient list with contacts, withdrawal of consent, deletion including processors, appeal with the Attorney General link, and no discrimination.
- It answers within 45 days, extendable once by 45 days. Requests are free twice a year. No new account is needed to make a request.
- There is no geofencing and no precise location.
- I found no clinic name, no emojis and no exclamation marks.

### B: must fix before merge
**B-611-1: two published claims are not yet true in production.** The fix is operator evidence, not code. Text: `trust-pages.html.ts:190` and `:369` ("If you leave it unticked, nothing about you is sent to Anthropic"), and `:239` (deletion flow).

1. **Anthropic only with box 2.** Main has client-data Anthropic paths with no box-2 check. Enforcement (R2b, #601) has not landed.
   - `POST /coach/ai/client-insight` (`src/ai/coach/coach-ai.controller.ts:94`) is gated only by Coach and Subscription.
   - The weekly per-client insight cron (`src/ai/coach/weekly-insight.cron.ts:57-60`) runs when `CRON_COACH_AI_INSIGHT=on`. That secret is set on Fly, and its value is unknown.
   - The coach brief cron (`coach-brief-enabled.guard.ts`) is ON by default, and `COACH_BRIEF_ENABLED` is not set on Fly. Its prompt carries aggregate roster and check-in counts.
   - The D2 contract says "until it lands, those paths stay off in production". S07b is still open.
   - *Fix:* before this merges (the next deploy publishes it), the operator records in LIVE_STATE either that these paths are off in production (`COACH_BRIEF_ENABLED=off`, `CRON_COACH_AI_INSIGHT` not `on`, and the coach AI endpoints unreachable or gated) or that R2b has landed.
2. **Deletion flow.** The policy describes the #608 flow ("You confirm with your password or Sign in with Apple, and deletion is scheduled straight away"). Production `bffae5f3` runs the legacy email-confirmation flow.
   - *Fix:* deploy #611 together with or after #608, and ship mobile #313 in the same build.

No new head is needed. Once the operator's evidence is recorded, a re-audit can approve at this same SHA.

### C: optional
- **C-611-1:** `:239`, "we ask Apple to revoke TGP's access". `APPLE_SIGNIN_KEY_ID` and `APPLE_SIGNIN_PRIVATE_KEY` are not on Fly, so #608 reports `not_configured`. Run the operator Apple workflow (#608 runbook 7b.1) before go-live.
- **C-611-2:** `:192`, "deleted automatically 180 days after each message". Main has no Roman retention job. Live Roman chat is off in v1.0 (D1), so no transcripts exist yet, but the retention job must ship before chat is enabled.
- **C-611-3:** `:193, :349`. Community AI moderation, if enabled, sends post content to Anthropic regardless of box 2. That conflicts with "nothing about you is sent". Keep `community/ai-triage` off until it honours box 2, or have the owner qualify the sentence.
- **C-611-4:** `:246, :388`, "download a copy in the app". `DATA_EXPORT_BUCKET` is unset, so exports land in `/tmp` on one Fly machine (ENV_TRUTH B). Confirm that export works end to end before go-live.
- **C-611-5:** `:107, :285, :308, :419, :430, :500`. The published pages say "counsel review is recommended before relying on it". This is approved copy and an owner call, but App Review and regulators will read it.
- **C-611-6:** `:435`, "sign up as a client or as a coach". This depends on the D4 outcome (client-only if #306 misses Friday).
- **C-611-7:** `test/trust-pages.spec.ts:209` checks the `main.ts` exclude by string match only. Optionally, add an HTTP test with the real `setGlobalPrefix` options.

### Checks run (heavy.sh, `--runInBand`)
- `npx jest test/trust-pages.spec.ts test/help-pages.spec.ts test/public-pages.spec.ts`: **3 suites, 69 tests passed.**

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#611 @ e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

**A/B/C: 0/4/1.** Independent exact-head public-policy/deletion-help audit; owner-approved D2 wording is not reopened as a stylistic preference, but approval of wording does not establish its runtime or operational truth. [Candidate and approval record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611#issuecomment-5937089620)

### Prior B-611-1: purpose fixed, publication prerequisite still open

The earlier Sol community-purpose finding closes: the privacy paragraph and consumer-health recipient line now accurately describe five-way inbox sorting/summaries, 240-character excerpts, author/cohort/age, consented-member restriction and no replies/actions. The former “moderation” disclosure is gone. [Corrected disclosures, `trust-pages.html.ts:201,214,363`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts)

**B-611-1 (earlier Opus publication-evidence finding) remains open:** this head still promises “nothing about you” reaches Anthropic without box 2 and 180-day transcript erasure, while its actual coach client-insight path builds client context and calls Anthropic without consulting the ledger. #626 is an open enforcement dependency, and the candidate's string tests referencing its future paths do not enforce those promises. [Policy, `:198-201,382`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts), [actual client-insight call, `coach-ai.service.ts:156-176`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/ai/coach/coach-ai.service.ts#L156-L176), [enforcement dependency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/626), [earlier publication finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611#issuecomment-5938041862).

Minimal closure: operator evidence of deployed ledger enforcement/retention/deletion dependencies, or every affected egress route/cron disabled until enforcement is deployed; hold publication meanwhile. Also record the operated processor-deletion notification procedure and backup-retention evidence: “tell every service provider” and six-month deletion are commitments expressly admitted unverified in this PR, not behavior established by the local erasure manifest. The paired backend currently also has B-608-11 open. [Explicit evidence gaps and ship-order contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/611), [processor/backups promises, `trust-pages.html.ts:248,410`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts), [paired deletion audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/608#issuecomment-5942557125).

### New B findings — copy must match code

**B-611-2 — “only payment records” omits deliberately retained account-linked deletion state.** `trust-pages.html.ts:247` says “We keep only the payment records the law requires,” but #608 keeps a User tombstone and an own-token lookup hash for 30 days, can retain the provider ID while auth removal retries, and retains security/audit records; the new help page itself lists security/audit retention. This is not anonymous data merely because names are removed. [Policy claim](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/public-pages/trust-pages.html.ts#L245-L250), [tombstone/retry/receipt, `account-deletion.service.ts:712-731,792-828`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/117596803ecf48e424f9d4a9cefc47b7bcc71f78/src/account-deletion/account-deletion.service.ts#L792-L828), [help retention, `:717-721`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/public-pages/help-pages.html.ts#L717-L721).

Minimal fix: qualify the payment-only sentence and disclose the bounded pseudonymous completion receipt, minimal tombstone/retry state and existing security/audit retention; obtain owner approval for changed approved wording, and assert these truthful categories in rendered policy tests.

**B-611-3 — the new deletion page reintroduces a coach-unavailable signal that the paired mobile fix explicitly removed.** `help-pages.html.ts:719` promises clients “see that their coach is no longer available”; #313's C-313-3 fix instead says only “are no longer linked to you,” because no such server/UI notification is implemented. [New help promise](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/e5777735a9df2fa8167bcb302d1a0f7dbf617a38/src/public-pages/help-pages.html.ts#L719), [paired fix disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/313), [actual retained-records copy](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4c6028d580d537a97af917d9515a8439140d652f/src/screens/settings/DeleteAccountScreen.tsx#L74-L81).

Minimal fix: use the neutral unlink wording here too, unless implementing and testing the signal as a separately graded change.

**B-611-4 — linked help still promises reversible deletion for thirty days, conflicting with the new fourteen-day irreversible flow.** `/help/faq` says deleted clients are in a “thirty-day soft-delete window” and can recover during that window (`help-pages.html.ts:453`); `/help/support` offers reversals within it (`:493`), while new `/help/delete-account:728` and #608 use fourteen-day grace followed by permanent erasure.
